footer.brandDesc: Independent comparison of research-peptide shops: prices per mg, lab reports checked on the issuing lab's portal where possible. Research use only.
footer.ruo: Research use only: all products listed are sold as laboratory reagents, not for human or animal use. No medical advice.
footer.affLine: Store links to partner shops are affiliate links (rel="sponsored"). Rankings use the audit score only, never commission.

about.title: About PeptideLabIndex: Editorial Standards
about.description: Who runs PeptideLabIndex, how we collect data, why commission never changes a score, how to send corrections and which links are affiliate links.
about.h1: About PeptideLabIndex and our editorial standards
about.intro: PeptideLabIndex compares research-peptide shops on facts we can check: lab reports, measured content, portal verification and listed prices per mg. Reviews are written by the PeptideLabIndex Editorial team. On {date} we audited {shops} shops and opened {reports} lab reports.
about.whoP1: All reviews, rankings and guides are written and checked by the PeptideLabIndex Editorial team. We publish under the team name and do not claim medical, legal or laboratory credentials.
about.whoP2: We do not test samples ourselves. Our expertise is reading what shops and labs publish and putting it side by side in the same format.
about.indepH: Independence: scores never depend on commission
about.indepP1: Some shops are affiliate partners. They pay us a commission when a reader buys through our link. The score formula is the same for every shop, partner or not.
about.indepP2: Partner shops score between {min} and {max} out of 5. For example, {low} scores {lowScore} while {high} scores {highScore}. Non-partners such as {np} ({npScore}) can score higher than some partners.
about.indepP3: Rankings sort partner shops by audit score only. Shops without a partnership keep their score and are listed with a link to our review.
about.dataL1: Desk audit on {date} of public shop pages: products, prices, shipping, terms and imprint.
about.dataL2: {reports} lab reports opened; lab, test date, purity, label mg and measured mg recorded.
about.dataL3: Reports looked up on the testing lab's own portal where one exists: {portal} found there.
about.dataL4: No test orders and no own lab tests. A desk audit cannot confirm what an individual parcel contains.
about.corrP: Shops and readers can send new lab reports or point out errors through our contact page. We check every report on the lab's site before we use it, and each page shows the date of the last check.
about.coiP: These shops are affiliate partners and get a store link (marked rel="sponsored"): {list}. All other audited shops get no outbound link.

contact.title: Contact PeptideLabIndex: Corrections & Shop Updates
contact.description: Contact the PeptideLabIndex Editorial team by email: send corrections, new lab reports for the next audit or partner questions. We reply by email.
contact.intro: The quickest way to reach the PeptideLabIndex Editorial team is by email.
contact.l1: Corrections: the page address and what is wrong, ideally with a source.
contact.l2: New lab reports from a shop: the report link and, if available, the lab portal key.
contact.l3: Partner and shop questions: see also our page for shops.
contact.note: We do not answer questions about human or animal use of any product, and we give no medical advice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | PeptideLabIndex
privacy.description: Privacy policy of PeptideLabIndex: cookieless Plausible analytics without personal data, affiliate links that set cookies on shop sites, and email contact.
privacy.intro: Short version: we do not set cookies and do not collect personal data on this site.
privacy.anaP: We count page views with a self-hosted Plausible Analytics instance. It does not use cookies, does not store IP addresses and does not build user profiles. We only see totals such as page views and referring sites.
privacy.affP: Links marked "Visit" go to partner shops. When you click one, the shop's own site may set a cookie to record that you came from us. That cookie is set by the shop, under the shop's privacy policy, not by this site.
privacy.toolP: The concentration calculator runs in your browser. Inputs are not sent to us.
privacy.mailP: If you email us, we use your address and message only to reply. We do not add it to a mailing list.

terms.title: Terms of Use | PeptideLabIndex
terms.description: Terms of use for PeptideLabIndex: research-use-only scope, no medical advice, no warranty for shop data, and the date our data was last checked.
terms.intro: By using this site you accept these terms.
terms.ruoP: The products compared on this site are sold by the shops as research-use-only laboratory reagents. They are not approved for human or veterinary use. We give no information on such use.
terms.medP: Nothing on this site is medical, legal or professional advice.
terms.dataP: Prices, stock, lab reports and shop details come from public sources and were read on {date}. Shops change them often. Check the shop and the lab portal before you rely on any figure. We are not responsible for the products, prices or services of any shop.
terms.linkP: Links to partner shops are affiliate links. Lab report addresses are shown as plain text; type them into your browser yourself.
terms.reuseP: The open data set may be reused under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to PeptideLabIndex.

affiliate.title: Affiliate Disclosure: How PeptideLabIndex Earns
affiliate.description: How PeptideLabIndex earns: affiliate links to partner shops marked rel=sponsored, reader codes issued to us, and why commission never changes a score.
affiliate.intro: PeptideLabIndex is free to use. We earn money through affiliate links to some shops. This page explains how that works and what it does not change.
affiliate.howP: Links marked "Visit" go to partner shops and carry rel="sponsored". If you buy through such a link, or use a reader code a partner issued to us, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
affiliate.partnersP: {n} audited shops are partners at the moment, listed here by audit score:
affiliate.notL1: The score formula is the same for every shop.
affiliate.notL2: Rankings sort partner shops by audit score only, never by commission.
affiliate.notL3: Weaknesses stay on the page whether a shop is a partner or not.
affiliate.notL4: Shops without a partnership keep their score and are listed with a link to our review, without an outbound link.
